notes.title: January 2025 Update
notes.notes:
Happy New Year Acolytes!

This update introduces additional visual style and bug fixes. Hope you enjoy!

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Charge to Awakening Bear.
[*] Added an animation that plays when entering the Time Portal.
[*] Fixed a bug that inadvertently caused a monster’s Bite ability to deal more than 2 damage at the start of an encounter.
[*] Fixed an error that prevented some cards from being improved or weakened in events.
[*] Card improvement and weakening animations now show correctly.
[*] Fixed some grammatical and spelling errors.
[/list]

notes.title: December 2024 Update
notes.notes:
We've got an [i]eventful[/i] update for you today! That's right, we've added more [b]Events[/b] that you can encounter in the wastelands!

Thank you for playing and supporting Acolyte of the Altar. We hope you enjoy the new content and wish you and yours happy holidays and a fantastic new year!

[h2]Full Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added seven (7) new Events to encounter! Vary your runs even more with new choices to make, including some Events that have unpredictable outcomes, Events that have Patron-specific choices, and more…
[*] The Rites you have enabled in a Run is now visible while in-game.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Loaine’s Tooth now doubles Shuddering Bundle’s Play ability correctly.
[*] Infected Nomad can’t be played on a full board if its Dominate has been reduced to zero.
[/list]

notes.title: November 2024 Update
notes.notes:
Greetings Acolytes! The latest update introduces new content in the form of additional Gifts that can be found after completing certain objectives (as listed in the full patch notes below).

Additionally, we’ve addressed issues that some folks have been having that involve failing to unlock Achievements. In addition to adding two completely new Achievements, now the unlocking of Achievements should be more reliable in general, and most of them can be unlocked retroactively when you open the game.

[h2]Full Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added five all-new Gifts! One for each of the final Bosses, one that can be found after unlocking all of the Cards in the library, and one that can be found after unlocking all of the Bestiary entries.
[*] Added two new Steam Achievements and improved the reliability of unlocking all of the achievements in general.
[*] Changed Fungal Explosive to Explosive Chain, which reads “Deal 4 damage. Next turn, deal 8 damage. The turn after, deal 12 damage, then the following turn deal 16 damage.”
[*] Changed Awakening Bear to a (4) mana 2/2 with Fearless and “If you’ve attacked this turn, I cost 1 less.”
[*] Changed Tacklewire’s text to “Start of Turn: I move as close as I can to the center of your board, then I give adjacent allies +1/+1.”
[*] Changed Goat with the Man’s Body’s text to clarify that the discover effects you choose do count as spells you play (for Giant Lantern, for example).
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed you to play Infected Nomad on a full board when its Dominate cost had been reduced to 0.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Arcana ability of a monster to change inadvertently after returning to the main menu.
[/list]

notes.title: October 15, 2024 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello Acolytes! We hope you are enjoying the full suite of Fabled cards available with the release of Wave III last week!

Today we're releasing a hotfix that addresses some bugs that have been reported in our Discord server (thanks PyroTheReaper!), and adjusting the balance for some of the cards that have been underperforming.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a softlock when a player ended their turn after dying.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused your Borrowed Life and Shuddering Bundle’s health to be inconsistent.
[*] Beast Torturer now activates its ability reliably.
[/list]
[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fish Eye Strike now deals 8 damage (up from 7).
[*] Artillery Fodder now gains either Fearless or +1/+1 and Charge (instead of Fearless, +1/+1, or Charge)
[*] Savory Medicine was changed from “Halve all damage you would receive until your next turn.” to “Reduce all damage you and your creatures would receive by 1 until your next turn.”
[*] Worship the Crown now summons a Venerated Bug instead of a Lord Bug.
[/list]

notes.title: Fabled Card Update Wave III
notes.notes:
We have added 25 all-new Fabled variants for cards, rounding out the Card Library with Wave III of the Fabled Update!

Here's a list of the cards that have new variants:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43754306/012b2193946982ede76d02c1336dcaace5e6c36d.png[/img]
[h2]Full Patch Notes:[/h2]
Additions
[list]
[*] Added tooltips to the Gift Selection screen.
[*] Added new Filter options to the Card Library.
[/list]
Changes
[list]
[*] Reduced Monarch Pupa from a 4/4 to a 3/3.
[*] Bound Fury now keeps its -5/-5 debuff until the beginning of your NEXT turn instead of until the end of the current turn.
[*] The Doppelgangers ability now gives a copy of the first spell card that you play that costs 1 or more each turn instead of the first spell card you play each turn.
[*] Updated the Sylvan starting deck by replacing a Hibernate with a Charging Bear. (Thanks to Discord user Wusuo for the suggestion!)
[*] Splice was changed from “Add five base copies of that card to your hand” to “Add two copies of that card to your hand and shuffle three copies of it into your deck.”
[*] Lively Statue was changed from a 5 mana 1/7 that read “End of Turn: Restore 1 health to my neighbors and move to the Frontline” to a 4 mana 0/6 that reads “I deal damage equal to my health rather than my attack.”
[/list]
Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that showed incorrect Rites being active after exiting and re-entering the Loadout Selection screen.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented Dignified Disciple’s Death trigger from being activated when multiple creatures died at the same time.
[*] Spear Runner now triggers its Rally if it’s the last card in your hand when played.
[*] Sunlit Spear doesn’t trigger anymore when the monster hits its own face.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix for September 13, 2024
notes.notes:
This small patch fixes an issue that prevented players from being able to unlock the new variant for Chanting Cultist.

We hope you are enjoying the cards in Fabled Wave II!

notes.title: Patch Notes for Hotfix - August 13, 2024
notes.notes:
This patch fixes a softlock that was plaguing some Acolytes related to the unlocking of Fabled cards and maintenance of progression files.

Additionally,
[list]
[*]Cards that have Fabled variants available now show a notification above them in loot screens.
[*]There's a new Screen Shake toggle in the settings menu.
[*]After completing a run, you can now skip the Outro sequence by holding any key.
[*]The music volume level is saved and loaded correctly now.
[/list]

notes.title: Fabled Card Update
notes.notes:
Dear Acolytes,

This update introduces the first wave of Fabled cards, powerful card variants that are unlocked by completing runs. Fabled cards will be released in waves with each monthly release from now until November. For now, here is a list of cards that currently have Fabled variants:

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43754306/ed2dec987afd2ab343bef22b884e1bae2224edfd.png[/img]

May your wasteland journeys be fruitful!

[h2]Full Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]Additions[/h3]
• Added Fabled cards, powerful variants that are unlocked after completing a run!
• Added a drop-down filter to the Card Library for viewing Fabled cards.
• After completing a run, you now view the cards in your deck as a summary of your achievement.
• The loadout screen now shows your current Rite level when you exit out of the Bones  screen.
[h3]Changes[/h3]
• Increased Tiny Hoof’s burden cost from 3 to 4.
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
• Creatures that can’t attack no longer automatically damage the Hydrozoan Hivemind’s jellyfish friends at the end of the turn.
• Fixed a bug that prevented some loot cards from being skipped reliably.
• Fixed a bug that caused Haru’s Ice Mirror ability to incorrectly damage your creature in addition to your face.
• Cards getting discarded from the top of your deck now display their animation correctly.
• Fixed a bug that caused Giant Lantern to trigger twice from Infest.

notes.title: Roadmap Update & Beta Testing
notes.notes:
[h2]Ready for something new, acolytes?[/h2]

In the months since launch, the entire Black Kite Games team has been working hard to bring you even more in the world of Acolyte of the Altar. Today, we're excited to share an updated road map, detailing the major game updates to come, starting in August!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43754306/dab4be0e5239e983aa4614ff6da633eb080fe519.png[/img]
We can't wait to see what you all think of the new content! Make sure you follow us on our socials to keep up with when the updates go live and see what the community is up to in the meantime.

[h3]Want early access to the Fabled Card Update?[/h3] Join our discord, download AotA from the beta branch on Steam, and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FTpfDHzrK6t]bug hunt[/url] with the community! More details will be posted there.

[b]Also, if you want to learn about some of the Fabled cards before they launch, our discord will be doing card reveals every [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FTpfDHzrK6t]Monster Monday![/url][/b]

That's all for now! Back to the Fading Forest we go.

- The BKG Team

notes.title: Last Day of Sale: First Look at MAJOR Content Update!
notes.notes:
[h2]It's the last day of the Summer Sale![/h2]

Welcome, new acolytes! We're so glad you're here.

Immediately after the launch of Acolyte of the Altar, we shared a Road Map of planned updates and new content. We are still hard at work with implementing these additions and changes, but we can finally share a first look of what's to come:

[h2]Fabled Cards Update[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43754306/12fc202404bd01b0bfd760e4e78b9c04c1825333.gif[/img]
[h3]Rumors circulate among Acolytes of fables almost too improbable to believe - those that involve ancient, near-forgotten variants of creatures...[/h3]

Fabled cards are shiny, alternate versions of cards that have unique effects. They can be obtained by [i]Deciphering[/i] cards in your deck after completing a run, which adds the Fabled card as a potential reward for future runs!

The Fabled cards will be yours soon, along with many other features. Be on the lookout for an updated roadmap in the next couple weeks! Thanks again for being along for the ride, acolytes! We couldn't do this without your support.

- The BKG Team

notes.title: July 5, 2024 Update
notes.notes:
Hello Acolytes!

We hope that you are enjoying the Steam Summer Sale! It's been a month since our last update and we have been hard at work improving the quality of the game to make it the best that it can be. We are proud to announce another patch, including the addition of saving progression data using Steam's Cloud service.

Below is a list of the most important changes that we've added to the latest version.

Additions
- Cloud Saves are now enabled! Feel free to start a run on one PC and finish it on another.
- Added buttons that filter cards by Patron to the Card Library.
- Added final bosses Loaine, Knest, and Haru to the Bestiary.

Changes
- Shuddering Bundle now gains 2 Borrowed Life on Play in addition to at End of Turn.
- Earthcarver’s Chains now costs 1 burden instead of 2.
- Increased Uncovered Goldcap’s starting life total to 36.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug that would sometimes replace a card in your deck inadvertently while Looting.
- Fixed a bug that would sometimes spawn an unusable Tiny Disciple card when clicking and dragging from a specific place on the screen.
- Adjusted the location of UI elements on screen to ensure that they are not cut off on certain aspect ratios.
- Updated the Loot Screen to clarify when a card is available or unavailable for looting.
- Fixed a bug that incorrectly applied Multicast from Ancient Gong to Language of the Deep.

…plus various other small bug fixes, quality of life improvements, and structural changes to prepare for future additions!

notes.title: June 3 Balance Update Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Greetings Acolytes!

We are proud to announce a balance patch including changes that we have been working on as part of our roadmap towards more robust improvements to the card pool and the general quality of life of the game experience.

The most substantial improvements are geared toward increasing the playability of some things we felt were unfairly neglected, including Pass Down The Crown, Brain Drinker, and Tiny Hoof. Additionally, encounters against Beasts such as Hydrozoan Hivemind and The Crumbling City have been revamped in order to increase the strategic options available at the player's disposal and to achieve more equitable chances of success for a wider variety of deck archetypes.

Here are some of the more noticeable changes included in the patch, although there are more minor bug fixes and general improvements not mentioned below.

Buffs
• Afflicted Nomad’s triggered ability now deals damage whenever an enemy ability is Ignited in addition to whenever one is Infested.
• Made Pass Down The Crown more playable by changing its Seasons requirements from Summer, Fall, and Winter to Spring, Summer, and Fall.

Nerfs
• Removed Overkill from The Yearning Woods’ Hanger Tantrum.
• Crows summoned by Prophet of Ruin now fulfill the Self-Fulfilling Prophecy even when they die from being overflowed from the board.
• Increased Radd-Head Trapper’s mana cost from 2 to 3 and increased its Attack from 1 to 2.
• To allow creature-deficient decks to stand a chance, Uncovered Goldcap’s rage requirements for its abilities have been changed to be 1 for Befuddling Spores, 2 for Wind-Up Punch, and 3 for Fungi Flurry.
• To curb the multiplicative increase of infestations from Marrow Maggot, it was changed from a 3/2 that Infests two random abilities when it attacks to a 3/3 that Infests one random ability when it attacks.
• Increased the cooldown on Maestro Maev’s Crescendo ability from 3 to 4 turns in order to encourage more viable strategies against her.
• Increased Burden cost of Bundle of Snakes from 1 to 2 in order to increase the challenge against Borrowed Life deck archetypes.

Reworks
• To increase synergy with the rest of the card pool, Brain Drinker’s passive ability has been changed from “When you reduce my mana cost, do it three times” to “The first time you cast a spell each turn, reduce my cost by 1”.
• In order to form a more cohesive encounter with more of a strategic sense of push and pull, The Shambling City’s Titanic Strike ability has been changed to Excavate, which is a Counterattack that deals 5 and refills its Remaining Residents by the amount overkilled.
• Reworked Tiny Hoof from “When you summon a creature with Frontline, grant it +2 health” to “Grant the first creature you summon each turn +1 health, or +2 health if it has Frontline” to improve its synergy with the rest of the card pool.
• Reworked the Hivemind ability to “Creatures that could have attacked, but did not, deal their damage to the oldest Jellyfish, and take damage equal to its remaining counters.” This change offers more strategic options to the encounter since you can now choose between damaging the Hivemind directly or picking off its Jellyfish friends one by one.
• Reworked Lord Bug from a 5/5 with “Overlord: Summon two Lone Ladybugs” to a 4/4 with “Overlord: Grant myself +1/+1 and summon a Lone Ladybug” and reworked Monarch Butterfly from a 6/6 with “Overlord: Summon two Lord Bugs” to a 5/5 with “Overlord: Grant myself +1/+1 and summon a Lord Bug” with the intent to reduce their tendencies to overcrowd one’s board.

Bug Fixes
• Damage based on the percentage of the enemy’s maximum health now scales correctly against the Prophet of Ruin after the Self-Fulfilling Prophecy is fulfilled.
• Fixed a bug in the Gilded Grifter encounter that would display damage intended as being dealt to creatures when it would really be dealt to the player.
• Grafting a card with a reduced cost no longer resets the card’s cost.
• Death March now generates the correct amount of mana reliably.

Clarity Improvements
• Clarified vocabulary and/or improved wording on Man With The Goat’s Head, Death March, Ferrous Firebomb, Sword Runner, Wave of Lava, and Wildfire Drake.
• Reworded Infest abilities to “bursting infestations” rather than “summoning your infest creatures”.

notes.title: April 1st Patch
notes.notes:
Ravagers have been struggling to rip and tear across the wastelands compared to their feathered Empiricist rivals, who have been hiding behind Borrowed Life in relative safety. This patch reduces the simplicity of forming such protective nests, as well as provides some early survivability to key Ravager units, including the pivotal Vent Crawler passive. You'll also find some clarity and function updates to Infest which are an intended buff to the Sylvans, to make that archetype more self-sufficient. 

Keeper's Rite's have been increased in difficulty, as some players found the hardest challenges available still not a match for their card-flinging prowess. There are some bonus changes too, so read the full notes below if you'd like to be spoiled!

[b]Reworks:[/b]
Infest clarity rework. All cards with Infest can now give a +2 cost Metamorphose.

[b]Card Buffs:[/b]
Impling: 3/1 => 3/2
Vein Drainer: Life cost to summon 2 => 1
Death March: Now also draws a card to give you more fuel to play out!

[b]Card Nerfs:[/b]
Chanting Cultist: 1 Borrowed Life, +1 if you have another Cultist => +1 Borrowed Life flat.
Leviathan: 4 mana => 5 mana
Valdrada: 9/9 => 6/6

[b]Faction Buffs:[/b]
Ravager Vent Crawler: 1/1 => 2/2
Empiricist Healing: 3 per combat => 2 per combat

[b]Keeper's Rites:[/b]
Most of the rites have been made significantly more punishing. Face an even greater challenge!

[b]Major Bug Fixes:[/b]
Fixes a bug with Fearless, Skyscraper Sword and temporary buffs causing bouncing/unusual attack values.
Fixes odd behavior when trying to Double-Cast Swallow on a 1 hp unit.

notes.title: Slay the Spire meets Hearthstone as new card game sets release date
notes.notes:
Acolyte of the Altar is a roguelike deck builder that, on the digital table, more closely resembles a traditional collectible card game such as Hearthstone or Magic the Gathering than it does the likes of Slay the Spire or Monster Train. Built by Black Kite Games, founded in 2020 by former Red Dead Redemption 2 designer Cameron Reid, and inspired by the grand boss battles of Shadow of the Colossus, the Acolyte of the Altar release date has officially been confirmed, and you can try the game now with a free Steam demo.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Acolyte of the Altar Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43754306/865f58ad817c8d4b3edeab1a71a2b7209a67c767.png[/img]

[i][h3][b]Hello, acolytes![/b][/h3]

[b]We need a bit more time than we hoped to finish Acolyte of the Altar.[/b] Too often do games come out underdone, and we want to make sure the center is fully cooked and the edges are crisp. 

[h3][b]The good news is that we have a more exact release date: March 2024![/b][/h3]
These extra few months will allow us the time to create a perfectly baked game, as well as avoid the holiday season, which will result in more attention at launch and allow us to provide better post-launch support for you all. 

Thank you for understanding and following along in our journey (and baking metaphors.) This is what we love to do and, without you all, we'd have to do something else![/i]

To think that this was where we were at just a couple years ago, drawing early sketches of some imaginary, fantastical, and terrifying beasts:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43754306/908cafbe0667cee04d1df8191e0a0e5dcc7b8dcf.png[/img]
And now we are less than six months away from launch! It feels surreal. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43754306/b14a314b4b56efa65ee9033351da23cca6c93cb1.png[/img]

We hope you're all enjoying the demo in the meantime, and don't forget to keep up with our progress on our [url=https://linktr.ee/blackkitegames]socials[/url]!

[i][h3]Best, 
Cameron and the Black Kite Games Team[/h3]
[/i]

notes.title: Major Demo Update and Bug Hunt Event: Bone Keepers
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello, acolytes! You’re overdue for a big update, and we certainly have one for you.[/h1]

As many of you know, we launched the Acolyte of the Altar demo at [i]Steam Next Fest[/i] back in June, and it was a great success! We gained thousands of wishlists on Steam, and had multiple content creators in the card game world try us out and share us with their audiences. It was an amazing beginning of our home stretch to AotA’s full game release.

Much of the credit to our demo’s success is because of you, acolytes. Everyone who gave feedback on the demo, and all of you who participated in our Bug Hunt event over in the discord provided us with the resources to fine-tune AotA in ways, as a five-person dev team, we would not have been able to otherwise. Thank you for all of your efforts in helping our game be the best it can be!

[h2]Now, for the upcoming news:[/h2] 
In just a couple weeks, we are pushing a [i]major[/i] update to the demo: [b]Keeper’s Rites[/b] mode. Each time you complete a run successfully, you may choose one of the Keeper’s Bones: unique features that will increase the difficulty of your journey. The more rites you complete, the more bones you can activate on your next run. We are excited to see how this brings more replay-ability and customization to the experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43754306/986f6b86dc6cb275dbb6be892e101f321189258f.png[/img]

Because this is a major update to the game, we are asking for your help once more. [b]From August 21st-August 27th[/b], get ready to participate in [b]Bug Hunt: Bone Keepers Edition.[/b] Join the Acolyte of the Altar Discord [url=https://discord.gg/7sRDf9tdxN]here[/url] to be notified when the demo goes live and connect with your fellow acolytes as we all submit bug reports, give suggestions, and prepare for our next big Steam press event!

*To peel back the curtain a bit, Steam wishlists are key to the success of indie game releases, and with 2.3k currently, we need to keep momentum to reach our goal of at least 7k. We’re confident that announcing this new demo update will give us the push we need to grow our wishlist count before launch!

[h2]Acolyte of the Altar is [i]mere months away[/i] from release, and we are so thankful for all of you joining us on the journey. Let’s hunt some bugs![/h2]

- Cameron and the BKG Team
